source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your army has 3 rules:

- **Lethal Intent**: as the opponent's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) ends, if 1 or more of your **YNNARI** units were destroyed in it, pick 1 **YNNARI INFANTRY** or **YNNARI MOUNTED** unit of yours that had been within 6" of a destroyed unit; it may make a Normal move of D6+1" at most.
- **Lethal Surge**: once per turn, if a **YNNARI** unit of yours uses its Fade Back Agile Manouvre, that unit may make a **[surge move](vsdata:core-rule/surge-move)** (D6+1" at most) in place of a **normal move**.
- **Lethal Reprisal**: as the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) begins, pick 1 **YNNARI** unit of yours, other than a **TITANIC** unit, that is under its Starting Strength; it has [Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first) until the phase ends.
